issues_discovered: The faint dot grid is implemented as a fixed aria-hidden <div> inside the page container (matching the reference HTML structure) rather than body::before, which would create its own stacking context and paint over the window.
Scrollbar styles must live in the CSS Module (scoped .body class), not globals.css, because CSS Module class names are compile-time scoped and unreachable from globals.
A literal // specialities text node in JSX trips react/jsx-no-comment-textnodes; wrap it in a string expression {'// specialities'}.
JetBrains_Mono with weight 400/500/700/800 x normal/italic loads 8 font files; only italic 400 is used, so italic 500/700/800 are loaded but unused — candidate for a small cleanup.

decisions.situation: Reference HTML container query sets the mobile window border-radius to 14px, while the narrow-screen criterion describes a 'smaller' radius than the 13px base; the two conflict.
decisions.action: Followed the reference HTML literally (14px under 560px) because the handoff README names the reference HTML as the source of truth for exact values; the discrepancy is noted so review judges against the reference.
